recipe.title: Upma Recipe (Rava Upma)

ingredients.name: split urad dal ((skinned split black gram))
chana dal ((optional, adds nice aroma, Bengal gram))
cashews ((you may leave out if using peanuts) )
ginger
ingredients.prep_note: ½ to ¾ teaspoon minced or grated (optional)

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables ((fine chopped carrots, beans and green peas))

steps.text: Roast rava: On a medium heat, dry roast rava in a pan, stirring often until crunchy and aromatic. Do not brown it. Remove to a bowl and keep aside to cool down.
steps.label: Roast rava
steps.doneness_cue: until crunchy and aromatic. Do not brown it.

steps.text: Optional - Roast peanuts to garnish - Fry peanuts in 1 teaspoon oil until golden, aromatic and crunchy. Reserve aside to garnish. Soak dal - If you like your dal softer, you may soak them in ¼ cup hot water for 10 mins, drain & pat dry before using.
steps.label: Toast peanuts / soak dal
consumes_ingredients: split urad dal ((skinned split black gram))
chana dal ((optional, adds nice aroma, Bengal gram))

steps.text: Temper the spices: Pour oil to the hot pan & add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, urad dal & chana dal. Fry until the dal turns light golden. Add cashews and fry until they turn golden & aromatic. Stir in hing, green chilies, ginger and curry leaves.
steps.label: Temper spices
consumes_ingredients: split urad dal ((skinned split black gram))
chana dal ((optional, adds nice aroma, Bengal gram))
cashews ((you may leave out if using peanuts) )
steps.doneness_cue: until the dal turns light golden

steps.text: Saute for a minute & add chopped onions. Saute until transparent & add mix vegetables (optional) if using. Stir and cook covered until slightly tender.
steps.label: Cook vegetables
consumes_ingredients: mixed vegetables ((fine chopped carrots, beans and green peas))

steps.text: Boil water: Pour water and add salt.�Mix and taste test the water. It has to be slightly salty. If required add more and bring the water to a rolling boil.
steps.label: Boil water
steps.doneness_cue: bring the water to a rolling boil

steps.text: Make upma: Lower the heat. With one hand pour rava in a slow stream to the boiling water, while you incorporate it into the water with the other hand. (check video). Be quick at this stage. Stir everything once to check any lumps. Break up if any.
steps.label: Add rava

steps.text: Cover and cook on the lowest flame until the water is completely absorbed. This just takes 2 to 4 mins depending on the kind of pot or pan used. Add ghee and give a quick stir. Turn off and cover back to rest for 5 mins.
steps.label: Cook and rest
steps.attention_cue: Cover and cook on the lowest flame until the water is completely absorbed.

steps.text: Stir in the lemon juice and serve rava upma plain or with spiced peanut podi, chutney, pickle or curd. Garnish with roasted/fried peanuts.
steps.label: Finish and serve
